project.description: Prize Protocol is a Solana based watch-to-earn ecosystem where users earn Gems by engaging with sponsored content, which can be converted into $PRIZE tokens. Users can use $PRIZE to participate in Giveaways. The protocol also includes a Recycle feature that allows inactive or failed tokens to be converted into $PRIZE. Prize Protocol also utilises a community treasury model supported by portions of platform revenue to help fund ecosystem rewards and long term holder incentives.
project.public_notice: According to Rugcheck.xyz, the contract creator can make changes to the token contract such as contract metadata, disabling sells, changing fees, unrestrictive minting of more tokens, transferring tokens etc. Exercise caution.
